messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate detected in inference-prod-us-west1. symptom: repeated container restarts on 'redwood-inference' pods due to CUDA OOM during prefill. auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

alice (oncall): oncall here, joining bridge (zoom link). seeing alerts, pulling logs.

ben (infra): seeing CrashLoopBackOff for pod redwood-inference-7f9c in ns=inference-prod. node=gpunode-42. kube events show OOMKilled then Restarted.

alice (oncall): can you paste the latest container stderr?

ben (infra): ```
container=redwood-inference pid=1 stderr:
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 23.78 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total; 27.44 GiB already allocated)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/runtime/prefill.py", line 142, in prefill_batch
    kv_cache.reserve(batch_size, seq_len)
  File "/app/runtime/kv.py", line 78, in reserve
    torch.empty( ... , device='cuda')
RuntimeError: CUDA error: out of memory
```

carol (sre): that stack matches prefill long-context path. looks like a single tenant sent a ~70k token chat history that triggered large reserve.

kira (support): which customers impacted? any paid / enterprise?

dave (eng): telemetry shows traffic spike from tenant=acme-media at 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z with prefill_size=72,384 tokens. affected pods: 6 in us-west1.

carol (sre): current symptom: ~8% 5xx errors on infer route, p95 token latency +1.2s. total erroring requests ~1200 in last 5m.

alice (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit prefill window to 32k tokens globally 2) temporarily route non-enterprise to smaller model redwood-medium-8k 3) cordon gpunode-42 if noisy neighbor confirmed. executing now.

ben (infra): applying quick throttle: `kubectl apply -f /ops/rate-limits/prefill-cap-32k.yaml` -> applied.

ops-bridge: BRIDGE STARTED by alice (oncall) -> https://zoom.bridge/ops/4300009999. participants: alice, ben, carol, dave, kira.

alice (oncall): rolling update to routing rules to route tenant=acme-media to fallback-model small to avoid heavy prefill.

dave (eng): deploying hotfix to runtime that caps prefill reserve and trims KV pages: `hotfix/cap-prefill-32k` -> deploying image gcr.io/redwood/hotfix:cap-prefill-32k. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1982

ben (infra): after cap applied, restarts dropped from 6 -> 0 over last 2m. pods stabilized on nodes us-west1-a,b.

carol (sre): error rate fell to 1.1%, p95 latency trending down. still seeing elevated memory on node gpunode-42; leaving cordon until we confirm eviction.

kira (support): drafting customer note for tenants in affected window: "We experienced intermittent inference failures in US-West on 2026-03-17 due to extremely large context prefill requests. We throttled large prefill windows and routed requests to smaller model variants to restore service. If you saw errors, reply and we'll share logs." Want to send?

alice (oncall): ack. send to affected customers (list attached). prioritize enterprise accounts. include expected follow-up postmortem.

dave (eng): quick root cause hypothesis: no global soft-limit on prefill reservation + long-chat export allowed by some SDK clients led to thousands-token prefill request that exceeded per-GPU reserve heuristics. coldmodel swap didn't trigger due to routing policy.

carol (sre): action items assigned: 1) permanent guardrail: enforce server-side prefill cap 64k and per-tenant rate limiting (dave) 2) improve telemetry to flag prefill_size > model_window earlier (ben) 3) customer comms and credits (kira) 4) postmortem (alice).

alice (oncall): timeline: 14:02 incident alerted -> 14:06 rate-limit applied -> 14:09 hotfix deployed -> 14:12 stabilization. total customer impact window ~10 minutes.

kira (support): affected customers: acme-media (enterprise), beta-startup (paid), 10 free-tier tenants. recommending outreach to acme-media and beta-startup now.

dave (eng): uploading logs & perf traces to incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/4300009999/ . linking in postmortem.

carol (sre): leaving node cordoned for maintenance: `kubectl cordon gpunode-42`. scheduling node-level scrub to evict any leftover GPU allocations.

ops-bridge: BRIDGE ENDED by alice (oncall) 14:30. next: postmortem scheduled 16:00 today in #postmortems and doc owner assigned.

alice (oncall): closing thread here. will open postmortem doc with timeline, root cause, and follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
